content: CourtReserve event creation (2026-04-17) documents minimum registrants, cutoff relative to start, individual-date cancellation for drop-in events, manual action when enrollment falls after cutoff, customer withdrawal disabled by policy and cancellation emails (https://help.courtreserve.com/en/articles/1146549-creating-events-recurring-events-camps-and-classes). TeamUp individual-class cancellation (2026-09-16) preserves other series occurrences and offers refund/notification options (https://support.goteamup.com/en/articles/9327529-how-to-cancel-a-class-on-a-specific-date-and-time); offline refunds (2026-06-16) await admin confirmation after external transfer (https://support.goteamup.com/en/articles/9327696-confirming-offline-refunds). Lafu must specify session-start hold collision and post-cutoff enrollment policy; no competitor evidence validates the exact five-hour proof-hold business rule.
